blocks.raw: Duplicating a promotion creates an exact copy, including all its activities, qualifying conditions, and limits, and saves it as a new draft. Duplicate a promotion to save time and ensure consistency when you launch a new promotion that's similar to a previous one. You can then make any necessary adjustments before you submit it for approval.

blocks.raw: To duplicate a loyalty promotion, follow these steps:
blocks.text: To duplicate a loyalty promotion, follow these steps:

blocks.raw:
1. In the promotion list view, navigate to the loyalty promotion to duplicate.

2. Hover over the three-dot menu and select **Duplicate.**

3. [Configure the new loyalty promotion.](https://docs.capillarytech.com/docs/loyalty-promotions-creating-a-loyalty-promotion)
